# C : Results Archive {#results}

The aim of this section is to provide information on modelling results against historical data collected within Cockburn Sound and surrounding waters (where available), with outputs of various generations of the CSIEM. The model performance in predicting a range of relevant variables such as salinity, temperature, nitrogen, phosphorus and total chlorophyll-a, are assessed with a set of statistical metrics, and other supporting analyses.

This appendix is in progress during the active development of the model and being updated with the CSIEM modelling as it evolves.

## Synoptic-scale validation

A "high-level" annual-scale analysis of the model is undertaken for each model version during development. This is to provide a synoptic scale assessment of how key variables are predicted with different model configurations.

Time-series validation plots including the statistics for each site are available [<span style="color: blue">via the **MARVL-VIEWER** web-app</span>](https://csiem-mv.seaf.org.au). The app pull-down menus are organised based on model generation (select an entry with "Validation" to see model outputs).


## Context-specific validation

Context specific validation plots of key metrics are summarised in each chapter, and a quick-reference summary to these is provided in the below table.

**Table C.1.** Summary of context-specific model validation undertaken within each chapter of the CSIEM Science Manual.

```{r validation-summary, echo=FALSE}
library(kableExtra)

tbl_val <- data.frame(
  Area = c(
    # Hydrodynamics
    "Water level & tides",
    "Temperature (vertical profiles & moorings)",
    "Salinity (offshore, nearshore & within CS)",
    "Density structure & stratification",
    "Currents & residual circulation",
    "Exchange flows (CS-North transect)",
    "River plume connectivity",
    "D'Adamo regime analysis",
    # Water Quality
    "Nutrient concentrations (N, P)",
    "Chlorophyll-a",
    "Dissolved oxygen",
    "Light attenuation (K<sub>d</sub>)",
    "Sediment biogeochemistry (CANDI-AED)",
    # Ecology
    "Seagrass biomass dynamics",
    "Seagrass habitat suitability (HSI)",
    "Filter-feeder filtration",
    "Marine heatwave & SST"
  ),
  Notes = c(
    # Hydrodynamics
    "Water level has been validated against long-term records from Hillarys and Fremantle boat harbours, and assessed in terms of tidal and sub-tidal variability over many years. Refer to <a href='hydrodynamics.html#sec-water-level-validation'>Section 9.5</a>.<br><a href='validation/water_level_validation.html'>Water Level Validation Report Card</a>.",
    "Mooring and CTD profile comparisons across CS regions. Refer to <a href='hydrodynamics.html#synoptic-scale-validation-of-temperature-and-salinity'>Section 9.6</a>.<br><a href='validation/temperature.html'>Temperature Validation Report Card</a>.",
    "Comparison with DWER-CSMWQ, IMOS, and mooring loggers for offshore, nearshore and within-Sound regions. Refer to <a href='hydrodynamics.html#synoptic-scale-validation-of-temperature-and-salinity'>Section 9.6</a>.",

    "Net weekly flow through NS5 transect; wind vs exchange analysis. Refer to <a href='hydrodynamics.html#controls-on-water-exchange-and-flushing'>Section 9.8</a>.",
    "Plume extent vs satellite CDOM imagery (2021); nutrient transport to CS. Refer to <a href='hydrodynamics.html#river-inflow-events-influencing-cockburn-sound'>Section 9.11</a> and <a href='swan-river.html'>Chapter 10</a>.",

    "Bio-optical model validation of spectral light and K<sub>d</sub>. Refer to <a href='light-climate.html'>Chapter 15</a>.",
    "Sediment flux comparisons across five environments. Refer to <a href='candi-aed.html'>Chapter 12</a>.",
    # Ecology
    "<i>P. sinuosa</i> above/below-ground biomass vs depth. Refer to <a href='benthic.html'>Chapter 16</a>.",
    "HSI spatial patterns vs observed seagrass presence; habitat area sensitivity to K<sub>d</sub>. Refer to <a href='habitat.html'>Chapter 17</a>.",
    "Spatial filtration patterns compared with Lemmens <i>et al.</i> (1996). Refer to <a href='benthic.html'>Chapter 16</a>.",
    "Daily-average SST comparisons with satellite observations. Refer to <a href='heatwave.html'>Chapter 18</a>.<br><a href='validation/mhw.html'>MHW Tracker</a>."

kbl(tbl_val, escape = FALSE, align = c("l","l")) %>%
  row_spec(0, background = "#14759e", bold = TRUE, color = "white") %>%
```
